test_title: PYST 22 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain coded language 'SHARKS' is coded as 'OGNWDO' and 'BALLER' is coded as 'NAHHWX'. How will 'BESTIR' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter is shifted 4 letters backward in the English alphabet.

Given,

S H A R K S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3532b367a53344f9c0999b540bafa86ee81163577ab983fb9250e920b2929cee.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a029374f26d2f99a528273b6abc22be7b993b235e1ac1ad296f7961dffe0cdb.png] 

So, SHARKS : O G N W D O

And, B A L L E R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03cde9774f765edac8fc361d9c1b76afa8e0c3bb0eb826205ecbe9b60873c0b2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43bcef0ca0bba3061c797e5fd2851f94e1958b37e39945f74a4521d8fb632ae2.png] 

So, BALLER : N A H H W X

Now, B E S T I R:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8023845c416687ff1a56b29f33ab961b8223ca25a72292ac4482283dc12ec77d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccf78f72416d12c938c13fb0e8983796a9745d47aab9c0c6d88deb9766898801.png] 

So, BESTIR : X A O P E N

Among the given options, the pattern that matches the backward shifting rule is:

NEPOAX

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
